text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Sapporo Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару spots a decorative
lilac tree
in the waiting room, and is
overjoyed at finding a
supposed
good-luck omen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After saying her prayers to the great
gods of the
north, she leaves for the
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
